verdict.rationale: Operating a robotics simulation and training platform through natural-language commands is a fair axis for this kind of product, so it applies. The evidence only shows programmatic control: Python packages, ROS 2 services and actions, and RL frameworks. Isaac Lab's 'agent-ready' label refers to robot-learning agents, and the GR00T items describe robot skills rather than natural-language operation of the product, so nothing shows a conversational or natural-language interface.
